blocks.text: MRI taqatwar magnetic field aur radio waves se andaruni hisson ki tafseeli tasveerein banata hai. Is ka usool yeh hai ke tissues mein hydrogen atoms ki miqdar mukhtalif hoti hai, aur in atoms mein magnetic khoobiyan hain.

items: Tareeqa: mareez motor wali mez par letta hai jo taqatwar magnet wale bare tube-numa scanner mein khisakti hai. Radio waves jism ke hydrogen atoms se signal nikalwati hain jinhein receiver pakarta hai; computer tafseeli teen-jihati tasveer banata hai.
Istemal: dimagh, spinal cord aur andaruni aaza jaise naram tissues ki tasveer, aur khoon ki nalyon aur kuch tumours ki kharabi dhoondna.

blocks.alt: MRI scanner ka kata hua manzar. Mareez motorized table par leta hai jo scanner ki surang mein khisakti hai. Surang ke oopar aur neeche bare magnet coils hain aur surang ki deewar par radio waves source hai.

blocks.prompt: MRI scan mein signals kaunse atoms dete hain?
blocks.explanation: Jism ke tissues ke hydrogen atoms, jinhein taqatwar magnetic field mein radio waves signal dene par majboor karti hain.

items: MRI: magnet + radio waves; hydrogen atoms signal dete; dimagh aur spinal cord jaise naram tissues ki 3D tasveerein.
